transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Let's start. Samir messaged that he's running a few minutes behind.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen

transcript.text: Sure. So most of the machined stuff for the hip build is confirmed. The housings are split, half shipped Friday and the rest are still at the shop. I asked for a ship date on the second half twice, no answer yet 😬

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Who's your contact there now?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Same guy, he's just slow on email. I'll call him after this 📞

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: I think the second half is the ones with the tighter bore callout, probably. Not 100% sure but that might be why they're slower.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Find out. If it's the tolerance, I want to know before Nora's team starts kitting around them.

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Okay, I'll ask.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Fasteners and consumables are fine, I reordered the loctite and the zip ties last week 👍

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Good.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: hey sorry. ok i'm here

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Samir, go ahead, your list.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: ok so quick round. quotes for the arm brackets came back, two of the three are reasonable, the third one is kind of out there so i'm probably not using them. i'd like to place by thurs. wed maybe, if Sofia's ok with the rev

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: the ankle stuff, still waiting on DFM comments, they flagged a thin wall i think but i haven't seen the markup yet

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: I saw it. It's the pocket near the flexure. Probably fine if they go a little slower on it, I think.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: ok so we accept as is?

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Let me check with Priya first, I don't want to sign off on her part.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: fair. and then the cable assemblies, the supplier went quiet again. i'll chase eow. or tmrw, eow is too late honestly

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Tomorrow. And copy me.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: yep

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Oh, and the label printer rolls came in wrong size again 🙄 I'm returning them

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: that's like the third time

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Fourth 🫠

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Kofi, anything from the NPI side?

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Mostly the bore thing. And Nora asked whether we can get first article reports on the hip housings before they ship next time. I think that's reasonable, probably.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Make it a line on the PO going forward. Talia, can you add it to the template?

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Yep on it ✍️

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: also unrelated, are we doing the team lunch thing this month or

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: After the build. Not this week.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Electronics. I spoke to Farah this morning. Driver PCBA respin for torso and pelvis structure (crossbeam), that's moved to 9/18. It was the sixteenth.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Ok, I'll update the tracker 👍

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Does that touch the bring-up plan? I think Farah had stuff lined up for the start of the week.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: That's hers to sort out. We just track it.

transcript.speaker: p-samir
transcript.text: ok noted. 18th

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: Anything else? Otherwise we're done early for once.

transcript.speaker: p-talia
transcript.text: Nope, all good 😊

transcript.speaker: p-kofi
transcript.text: Nothing from me.
